comments.1: Listen for what is troubling the narrator about the old man.
comments.2: He says the old man’s eye troubled him, not the man himself. What happens after his thumb slips against the lantern?
comments.3: He says he hid the body so carefully that there was no sign of it. But can he stay calm when the police arrive?
